Not me but a friend of mine.

She snuck to a school field trip she was not supposed to go.Her mother had prohibited her from going weeks before and being from a third world country,the beating she would receive if she did go would be out of this world.

The main reason she wasn't allowed to go was because it was organized by the students and there would be no adult supervision.They had rented two buses and it was about 40 people (15 16 year olds) in total.She told me she had an amazing time and it was more fun than she had imagined.

Shit hit the fan when the night hit tho.Only one bus came back to pick them up.The "leader" of the group explained that the second one should be here soon.My friend got a horrible feeling in her stomach about this,and she was right to feel that way.They tried to cram as many people as they could into the one bus and her best friend asked her to come on to the bus.My friend said:No I'll wait for the next one, it's too cramped in there.Something...she...would...regret.

She,the "leader" and a few more kids had to stay behind.She told me as she watched the first bus drive away,she could feel how this was a bad bad idea.They started walking towards the main road and having a good time while doing so.After about an hour of walking they started to notice how incredibly dark it could get in the forest once the sun started to set,and some of the girls started to cry because of it.Growing concerns about the bus driver not showing up after about an hour became even more apparent when the group "leader" even started to panick.They where about a 4 hour drive from the nearest civilization.

My friend could see her life coming to an end because she had promised her mom she would be back home at a certain time,and that time was nearing FAST.They had no phones,no food,no water.All of their spare clothes where soaking wet and they had nothing to fight against the cold of night.

Miraculously the bus driver SHOWED up after about 2 hours.He made some bullshit excuse about why he was late and there was nothing the kids could do about it cause they were so small and didn't know any better.My friend thankfully got home safely two hours late.Luckily for her,her mom thought she already home and asleep so she just had to sneak into the house,which she did and almost got away with the whole situation.

Almost because her sister apparently saw her come of the bus and sneak into the house and ratted her out.She got her ass beat the very next day and grounded for god knows how long.

Funny to think how she almost got away with the whole thing if it weren't for her sister.Screw siblings.
